evidence.note: Real ERP УХ 3.2.12.6 1cv8.cf storage entries, extracted with `ibcmd-rs cf extract <cf> <form-uuid>.0 <outdir>` (compression raw-deflate). Same root cause as the form-mobile-device-command-bar-content-navigator-gap and form-save-window-settings-navigator-gap fixtures: forms with a built-in Navigator/quick-search child item write one extra field ahead of the classic 24-member form-root trailer's own start -- a 25-member trailer, not 24 -- pushing every trailer slot counted from the front out by one. `FormRootGroupSchema` (Group, trailer slots 14/21) and `FormRootGroupingSchema` (HorizontalSpacing/VerticalSpacing/CollapseItemsByImportanceVariant, trailer slots 9/10/20) previously required trailer_len==24 exactly and read those fixed slot numbers; for a 25-member trailer the strict tail-start search found no valid count-list at all and the whole property silently disappeared. Confirmed on 4 native forms here (2 Group, 2 VerticalSpacing) plus 12 more sampled but not embedded, spanning Catalogs/DataProcessors/Documents/InformationRegisters -- 14/14 root-50 samples pass; the one root-49 (ERP УХ MDM_Management) sample checked is a different, unverified shape and stays out of scope (root-49 forms are handled separately elsewhere in this codebase, e.g. FormRootVerticalScrollSchema).
